g.text: L14 emotion atlas | Six fixed conditions, no praise
Change from R0 in the same item and choice rotation; 139 items × 3 repeated rotations per region
Schematic equal-area regions, not neural locations. Dark → emotion hue → yellow: increasing cosine change.
Cell positions carry no spatial meaning; rotations are repeated measures. Evaluation axes are reported separately.
